body:
The Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund (PERF) has approved $330m (€295m) in new commitments to Brookfield’s global infrastructure strategy.

The Oregon Investment Council disclosed during a board meeting that it committed $280m to Brookfield Infrastructure Fund VI and $50m to an associated co-investment sidecar vehicle on behalf of OPERF.

The council also approved a $20m commitment to Fund VI for the Oregon Common School Fund.

Brookfield has raised $9.3bn towards a $30bn target for the flagship vehicle, according to its second-quarter earnings report.

p: The Oregon Public Employees Retirement Fund (PERF)가 Brookfield의 글로벌 인프라 전략에 3억 3,000만 달러(약 2억 9,500만 유로) 규모의 신규 출자를 승인했다.
Oregon Investment Council은 이사회 회의에서 OPERF를 대신해 Brookfield Infrastructure Fund VI에 2억 8,000만 달러, 관련 코인베스트먼트 사이드카 펀드에 5,000만 달러를 출자하기로 했다고 밝혔다.
위원회는 또한 Oregon Common School Fund를 위해 Fund VI에 2,000만 달러의 출자를 승인했다.
Brookfield는 2분기 실적 보고서에 따르면, 300억 달러를 목표로 하는 플래그십 펀드의 펀드레이징에서 93억 달러를 조달했다.
